name: dosie
description: Intelligent Voice AI Agent System for Medication Monitoring

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.db:reset: docker exec dosie-postgres psql -U dosie -d dosie -c "TRUNCATE users, patients, medications, schedules, calls, alerts, patient_caregivers, schedule_medications RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;" && npm run db:seed
